_comment: Shipped preset for MiniMax H3 first/last-frame to video+audio (fl2va). The workflow is ComfyUI's bundled video_minimax_h3_i2v template plus a second outer LoadImage #200 wired into the subgraph's last_frame input (first frame is LoadImage #114). The inner MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo node is composite id 105:104; width/height come from the stage's resolution + aspect via computed:width/height (snap 32), duration_s feeds the inner PrimitiveFloat 105:111, seed the inner RandomNoise 105:15. With one image wired the run is plain i2v (the last-frame branch is pruned); with two it interpolates between them. mention_style=minimax_tags because the keyframes enter the model's presentation as <Picture 1> / <Picture 2>, so @image_N mentions in the prompt expand to those literal tags.
label: Local MiniMax H3 FLF2V
description: MiniMax H3 first/last-frame to video+audio. Wire ONE image for image-to-video, or TWO (first frame, last frame) and the model fills in the motion between them. The prompt guides motion, camera and the soundtrack; refer to the frames as @image_N. Generates 5s WITH audio. Requires the MiniMax H3 model files — see workflows/video/README.md.

image.error: MiniMax H3 FLF2V needs at least a first-frame image — wire one into the stage's first image slot.
